name: Thienorphine
summary: Thienorphine is a very potent, extremely long-acting, orally-active opioid analgesic with mixed agonist–antagonist properties which was developed by the Beijing Institute of Pharmacology and Toxicology as a potential non-addictive analgesic and treatment for opioid dependence.

pharmacology.text: Thienorphine is a very potent, extremely long-acting, orally-active opioid analgesic with mixed agonist–antagonist properties which was developed by the Beijing Institute of Pharmacology and Toxicology as a potential non-addictive analgesic and treatment for opioid dependence.

uses.text: Thienorphine is a very potent, extremely long-acting, orally-active opioid analgesic with mixed agonist–antagonist properties which was developed by the Beijing Institute of Pharmacology and Toxicology as a potential non-addictive analgesic and treatment for opioid dependence.

sideEffects.en: Little detail has been published. As a mixed agonist-antagonist like buprenorphine, it can be expected to cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and dependence, and it may bring on withdrawal in people who are dependent on other opioids.
sideEffects.zh: 已發表的細節很少。作為與丁基原啡因相似的混合型促效-拮抗劑，可預期它會造成嗜睡、噁心、便秘與依賴，並可能使依賴其他鴉片類藥物的人出現戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已发表的细节很少。作为与丁基原啡因相似的混合型促效-拮抗剂，可预期它会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与依赖，并可能使依赖其他鸦片类药物的人出现戒断症状。

fact.en: It was developed at the Beijing Institute of Pharmacology and Toxicology and is a thiophene-containing relative of buprenorphine, one of the Bentley family of opioids made from thebaine.
fact.zh: Thienorphine由北京藥理毒理研究所開發，是含噻吩的丁基原啡因近親，屬於以蒂巴因製成的Bentley鴉片類家族。
fact.zhHans: Thienorphine由北京药理毒理研究所开发，是含噻吩的丁基原啡因近亲，属于以蒂巴因制成的Bentley鸦片类家族。
